title: Vent
intro: Write whatever you need to, as messy as it comes. Nobody reads this.
how: The figure reacts to the words you use. It does not understand you, judge you, or tell anyone anything.
label: What is on your mind
tooLong: That is more than {max} characters. Let some of it out now, and write the rest after.
keepHint: Off: it is gone once you let it out. On: saved and encrypted, only for you, until you delete it.
kept: Kept. Only you can read it.
unavailable: The figure could not react just now. What you wrote is still here.

listening.line: Thank you for putting it into words.

heavy.figure: The figure sinks low and dims, staying with you.
heavy.line: That sounds heavy. You do not have to carry all of it at once.

racing.figure: The scattered light gathers and starts to breathe slowly.
racing.line: A lot is racing. If it helps, breathe with the figure: in as it grows, out as it settles.

storm.figure: The light flares and churns, then slowly settles.
storm.line: That sounds really frustrating. Anger is allowed. Let it settle in its own time.

alone.figure: A second light comes to sit beside the figure.
alone.line: Feeling alone is hard. Reaching one person, even with a short message, can help.

lighter.line: It sounds like something eased a little. Notice what helped.

steady.figure: The figure stays steady and close.
steady.line: What you wrote sounds really serious. Nobody has been told, and this app cannot respond to an emergency. You do not have to handle this alone.

distress: If this keeps building, Support has a breathing aid and people you can reach.
emergency: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call your local emergency number now.

entries.title: Kept entries
entries.empty: Nothing kept. Entries you choose to keep appear here, only for you.
